messages:
Maria: Pre-cut preflight for v1.12.0 — aiming to tag at 18:00 UTC. Need quick confirms: version bump, changelog, docs update, QA sign-offs, security clearance. I'll tag at cut if all green.

Jake: Version-bump PR is up: #3125. One reviewer left, tiny test name nit. Will ping the reviewer now. :thumbsup:

Oliver: I'll run smoke + perf at 17:15 UTC and paste results here. If anything flaky shows up I'll call a hold.

Keisha: Docs PR #3138 ready — added note about default max_batch_size and updated example output. Left a small TODO but won't block release.

Amanda: Ran security scan earlier. Static analyzer flagged credential logging (medium). Pushed a fix in #3142 and opened SEC-789 to track.

security-bot: Auto-scan results for PR #3142: 0 critical, 1 medium. SEC-789 created. Manual review requested from @Amanda and @Maria.

Maria: @Amanda can you confirm the patch removes the sensitive logging and we can resolve SEC-789?

Amanda: Verified locally and in CI — no credential strings in logs anymore. Marking SEC-789 resolved. :white_check_mark:

Jake: Reviewed #3125, left a tiny comment on test name. Will merge after that change.

Keisha: Changelog edited in #3139 (Unreleased -> v1.12.0). Linked the docs PR in the release description.

Oliver: Smoke + perf quick run (17:16 UTC):

```
2026-06-18T17:16:02Z smoke: start
p50=92ms p95=235ms p99=500ms
errors=0
```

No regressions observed.

sre-bot: Release window check OK. Infra quotas fine; GPU pool has capacity. Canary will be deployed to node-group canary-2.

Maria: Reminder: non-critical cutoff is 17:35 UTC (25m buffer before cut). If you need a post-cut hotfix, DM me with justification.

Jake: Fixed test name, merged #3125 -> main and pushed tag to the release branch.

Amanda: Security approval added and referenced on the PRs.

Keisha: Final docs + changelog are linked in the release PR. Good to go from docs side.

Maria: Final sanity at 17:50 UTC, will tag at 18:00 UTC if no objections. :party_parrot:

Oliver: I'll monitor post-cut smoke and perf for 30m and report regressions here if any.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled at 18:00 UTC for 10 minutes; auto-rollout configured if health checks pass.

Maria: Thanks all — speaking now is the last chance to block. If nothing by 17:50 I'll proceed to cut.
